test_title: PYST 25: SSC MTS - Reasoning (Held on: 14 July 2022 Shift 3)
subject: reasoning
question:
Read the given statements and conclusions carefully. Assuming that the information given in the statements is true, even if it appears to be at variance with commonly known facts, decide which of the given conclusions logically follow(s) from the statements.

**Statements:**

I. Some red are mouse.

II. No grey is mouse.

**Conclusions:**

I. All red are grey.

II. No mouse is grey.

options.text: Both conclusions I and II follow

solution:
Statements:

I. Some red are mouse.

II. No grey is mouse.

According to the given statements, the least possible Venn diagram is:

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/0847245711e70e225e6e95c71380787b6d8424fee8a243bdbc4a20697cda78e3.png] 

Now, checking the conclusions:

I. All red are grey → False (Because some red are mouse and no grey is mouse. So those red that is mouse will also not grey).

II. No mouse is grey → **True **(Because no grey is mouse so no mouse is grey is true).

Thus, Only conclusion II follows

Hence, the correct answer is '__**option 4**__'.
